meta.what: Coal unit decommissioning years for the IRP-timing sensitivity (TODO 14cr): a unit listed here is gone from the start of the year given; every unit not listed keeps c4's date (UC_FLEET).
meta.basis: Tracks IRP 2025's total coal path as read from Figure 3 (plan p.12, gazette p.23) by Nick Hedley, 13 Oct 2026: 50-year-life annual averages scaled to our 39,692 MW base, accuracy about +-250 MW (path_mw_scaled below). Closure order: the units of Camden, Hendrina, Grootvlei and Arnot first (named 'by the financial year 2030', plan p.40, gazette p.51), then every other unit, each group oldest first by GEM start year (ties: the station's first unit, then unit order); a unit retires in a year while the fleet stands at least half that unit above the path, so the schedule is within half a unit of the path every year (largest gap 243 MW; units 160-640 MW). Units still standing after 2040 keep c4's date if later, else 2041; neither reaches the LP (last model year 2040). Replaces the text-based path of 12 Oct (66819c2).
meta.source_start_years: Global Energy Monitor, Global Coal Plant Tracker, unit tables on gem.wiki (Arnot, Camden, Grootvlei, Hendrina, Kelvin, Kriel, Matla, Duvha, Tutuka, Lethabo, Matimba, Kendal pages), read 12 Oct 2026. Our file's operating units take GEM's operating units in unit order (half-station groups: first units to *, the rest to **); mothballed units (Duvha 3; Grootvlei 4-6; Hendrina 1, 3, 8, 9) are not in our file; Kelvin's two units take GEM's two oldest operating units (1962, 1964).
